eyebrow: Calling it many times, from Python
code:
import qsharp
from collections import Counter

results = qsharp.run("PrepareGHZ()", shots=1000)
counts = Counter(results)
print(counts)
caption: Each result is a tuple of three Result values — Counter tallies them with no quantum-specific aggregation needed.
